cell_qc.notes: Thresholds must be declared upstream or in plotting config; the plotting layer does not invent filtering cutoffs.

feature_variability.grain: one row per feature or feature-by-group
feature_variability.notes: selected must reflect the upstream HVG/SVG rule.

embedding.notes: Coordinates are treated as reviewed inputs and are not rotated, recomputed or re-embedded by the plotting layer.

group_feature.notes: Dot size, color and annotation tracks must each map to explicitly named fields.

effect.notes: Intervals and significance are upstream results; plotting never fabricates either.

enrichment_result.grain: one row per enrichment term and contrast
enrichment_result.notes: Signed enrichment effect, q-value and supporting count are upstream results. Count must retain its original definition.

gsea_profile.grain: one row per ranked position and enrichment profile
gsea_profile.notes: Running score, hit positions and rank metric must come from the upstream GSEA result; the plotting layer does not recalculate enrichment.

composition_effect.notes: Fractions must use a declared denominator and normally sum to one within sample.

trajectory.grain: state/time, lineage/time, feature/time or transition edge
trajectory.notes: Pseudotime, lineage, fate probability and transition mass are distinct semantics and must not be silently substituted.

interaction.grain: one row per directed interaction or LR edge
interaction.notes: Network direction and edge width must retain their upstream meaning.

spatial_point.grain: one row per spot/cell/segment coordinate, or per spatial unit-feature when gene is supplied
spatial_point.notes: Coordinate unit and aspect ratio must be declared; tissue boundaries are never inferred from scatter geometry unless provided by an upstream segmentation result. Gradient, pseudotime, probability, QC, domain and niche fields are accepted only when supplied upstream.

spatial_composition.notes: Fractions must sum to one within spatial unit when they represent composition.

spatial_effect.notes: Autocorrelation statistics remain named; they are not converted into generic significance scores.

moran_point.notes: Spatial lag must be computed upstream using the declared neighborhood/weight matrix. The plotting layer only displays the supplied Moran scatter coordinates.

model_metric.notes: Paired comparisons must preserve dataset identity rather than comparing unrelated aggregate distributions.

prediction.notes: Residual sign and uncertainty definition must be declared. Spatial prediction requires coordinates rather than reconstructing geometry from ordering.
